title: Information Sheet — List of Special Forces Camps
citation: Information Sheet - List of Special Forces Camps, 17 pp, no date. Dale W. Andrade Collection, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 24990306001.
notes: Typescript tables of Special Forces detachments with camp names and grid coordinates. Lists Det A-324 at Nui Ba Den with a grid in the XT28/58 area, alongside the other Tay Ninh province camps (Suoi Da, Ben Soi, Prek Klok, Trang Sup) under B-32.
